# References

These sources inform instrument conventions and task taxonomy. The generated images are original procedural drawings; no product photos, screenshots, figures, or source code are included.

| Image type | Reference | Use |
|---|---|---|
| Analog pressure gauge | [WIKA pressure gauges](https://www.wika.com/en-us/pressure_gauges.WIKA) | Catalog conventions for numbered pressure scales, pointer, and gauge face. |
| Composite pressure panel | [WIKA pressure gauges](https://www.wika.com/en-us/pressure_gauges.WIKA) | Same gauge conventions shown as two independently generated instruments on one panel. |
| Vernier caliper | [Mitutoyo calipers](https://www.mitutoyo.com/products/small-tool-instruments-and-data-management/calipers/) | Caliper scale and jaw-position conventions. |
| Graduated cylinder / meniscus | [ISO 4788:2005 — Laboratory glassware — Graduated measuring cylinders](https://www.iso.org/standard/33655.html) | Graduated-cylinder scale and reading convention. |

The original source also cites [MeasureBench](https://flageval-baai.github.io/MeasureBenchPage/) for task taxonomy, not as an image source. Its original reference notes say the Hugging Face dataset revision/license and the public repository license were not verified; this bundle contains no downloaded dataset, paper figure, or vendored repository code.
